title: Scaly Dream

outfit_card.silhouette: Asymmetric layered martial-arts couture featuring an open-front pinstriped half-coat, cropped inner bodice, wide belted midriff, and structured pleated split skirt layered with sheer shimmering panels.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Sculpted silver loong hair ornament clasping a topknot, accompanied by a circular metallic braid ring and dangling jade bead hair drops.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High-collared cropped emerald bodice with frog buttons and scenic wave embroidery, layered under a structured black pinstriped coat featuring bell sleeves with tiered pleated organza ruffles.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: High-waisted geometric-patterned black pleated wrap skirt adorned with semi-translucent sparkling plissé godets, secured with a broad cinnabar-accented obi belt and hanging gilded loong tassel ornament.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Scaled dragon claw motifs, fingerless lace armwear, auspicious red bead wristlet, and gilded dragon buckle with suspended dangling chime pendants.
